**No Thomas Flynn estate was found in any search.**

The only record that surfaced across all three searches was the estate of a *different* Patrick Flynn — born 1838, died 14 May 1882 in Pottsville — who has been recorded as namesake **ns_001** and ruled out (wrong birth year: 1838 vs. ~1845; wrong death date: 1882 vs. 1908).

The Thomas Flynn estate file very likely exists as an unindexed page image in the Schuylkill County Register of Wills.

**Namesake alert:** Two existing person-evidence links (pe_004, pe_005) on subject I1 may be tied to this namesake (Patrick Flynn, d. 1882), and a Death fact (F2) on I1 may have been copied through them — a person-evidence review is recommended.

- **Full-text search** — co-occurrence search of unindexed Schuylkill County probate volumes for "Flynn" + "Thomas" or "Patrick"
- **Image browsing** — page through the Register of Wills volumes for this period
- **Person-evidence review** — audit links pe_004 and pe_005 to confirm they belong to the correct Patrick Flynn
